milestone: SeLinOS Linux KAPI M2 fail-closed ioremap guard

platform.emulator: QEMU TCG instruction-count mode with QEMU edu fixture

contract.ioremap: For every physical address and size, canonical ioremap returns NULL before any seL4 operation; it does not allocate a device frame, map a VSpace range or return a register address.
contract.iounmap: iounmap accepts the NULL result as a no-op and does not revoke or unmap any device resource.
contract.probe_order: The EDU probe validates its scalar BAR metadata, proves ioremap returns NULL and calls iounmap(NULL) before pci_enable_device, pci_set_master, request_irq or DMA setup.
contract.irq_boundary: Existing token-bound EDU request_irq/free_irq behavior is unchanged; M2 does not implement a success-returning IRQ stub and does not grant a new IRQ authority.

required_markers: SeLinOS edu driver: KAPI M2 ioremap fails closed; no MMIO authority.
SeLinOS edu driver: KAPI request_irq and dma_alloc_coherent passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS edu driver: KAPI M2 no-authority ioremap guard failed.

not_claimed: device frame capability, MMIO VSpace mapping or cache-attribute policy
MMIO register access through ioremap or iounmap resource teardown
canonical request_irq/free_irq stub, new IRQ number or new interrupt authority
NIC/storage authority, IOMMU/IOSpace containment, DMA or bus mastering by this M2 guard
Linux driver completeness, package execution, dpkg or apt
